# SETUPSS (SAIOS v2.0) - Comprehensive Hardware & Workspace Intelligence Manifest

## About Setupss
Setupss (https://setupss.com) is a unified hardware knowledge graph and social ecosystem for PC builders, setup architects, and tech enthusiasts. It combines component specs, verified user setups, benchmark insights, and automated AI assistance.

## Key System Architecture & Entities

### 1. Setups & Workspaces (Masaüstü & PC Kurulumları)
Each setup in Setupss contains:
- Verified High-Res Media (Primary photo, multi-angle gallery, video tours)
- Itemized Hardware Specs Sheet:
  - Processor / CPU (e.g., AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D, Intel Core i9-14900K)
  - Graphics Card / GPU (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 Super, RTX 4090)
  - Memory / RAM & Storage (DDR5, PCIe Gen 4/5 NVMe SSDs)
  - Motherboard, Power Supply (PSU), Case, Cooling
  - Desk & Furniture (Standing Desks, Ergonomic Chairs, Cable Management)
  - Display & Audio (OLED 240Hz Monitors, Studio Monitors, Mechanical Keyboards)

### 2. Hardware Knowledge Graph Engine
Setupss links every hardware component directly to verified setups using it. This allows users and AI agents to query:
- "Which CPUs are most frequently paired with RTX 4080 Super in minimalist setups?"
- "What standing desks support triple 32-inch monitor arms?"
- "Real-world user setups featuring ITX SFF cases with 360mm AIO liquid coolers."

### 3. Interactive Tools & Calculators
Setupss provides embedded calculation utilities:
- **Bottleneck & Performance Auditor**: Estimates CPU-GPU throughput bottleneck percentage across 1080p, 1440p, and 4K resolutions.
- **Power & Thermal Budget Simulator**: Recommends PSU wattage and thermal cooling requirements for target builds.
- **Desk & Ergonomics Uptime Planner**: Calculates ideal desk height, eye-level monitor distance, and desk depth for multi-monitor setups.

### 4. API Endpoints for AI & Data Crawlers
- `GET https://setupss.com/feed.json`: Machine-readable JSON feed containing recent setups, full hardware arrays, and absolute image URIs.
- `GET https://setupss.com/api/v1/latest-setups`: Paginated JSON array of curated setups with full JSON-LD schema metadata.
- `GET https://setupss.com/sitemap.xml`: Complete XML sitemap updated daily.
